codex.text: Test a research-only two-consecutive-scan validated-state gate against the current gate across pre-registered scan cadences and representative market regimes. Before opening the sealed holdout, define a false entry as an entry whose fixed 30-minute post-entry mark-to-market return is negative after the runner’s documented spread and slippage costs, and opportunity loss as the net positive return captured by the current gate but missed or materially delayed by the candidate over the same horizon and cost model. Freeze the comparison methodology, thresholds, cadence set, regime labels, and analysis code before accessing the sealed holdout, then evaluate net expectancy, false-entry rate, opportunity loss, and trade count. Reject the candidate unless false entries decrease by at least 15% without net expectancy falling or trade count declining by more than 10% across the aggregate holdout and without failing any pre-specified cadence or regime robustness check; promote nothing.
